Classification: High Clan

Called the Fiends, the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.nyOuQ8xvZEiNEJbM]{Tzimisce} have ruled Eastern Europe since time immemorial, tied by blood-pacts to the old gods of the earth and to the land itself. Their lorekeepers, the koldun, tell how the clan founder left the Second City to carve out his own dominion in the mountains. The Dark Medieval finds the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.nyOuQ8xvZEiNEJbM]{Tzimisce} beset on all sides: the theft of Tzimisce blood that created the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} has provoked open war, Germanic @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.OpCOs3PLjmtl0QVu]{Ventrue} exploit the conflict to invade pagan enclaves in Lithuania and Livonia, and internal power struggles and hereditary feuds sap the clan's unity.

Disciplines: Animalism, Auspex, Vicissitude

Advantage: As lords of the manor, every Tzimisce gains either a Court or Political Influence Trait at character creation, plus a free Occult Ability from their pagan heritage. Tzimisce may keep revenants as Retainers, and revenant ghouls do not require regular maintenance with vitae.

Disadvantage: Every Tzimisce must take daily rest surrounded by at least two handfuls of soil from the land of her birth or her grave; failing to do so inflicts a two-Trait penalty on all challenges until she rests in her native soil for at least eight hours.

Organization: A rigid hierarchy of elders ruling childer who scheme and serve to curry favor, bound by respect for elders, personal honor, obedience to family, and devotion to the homeland.

Suggested Viae: Heaven, Kings. Some follow the cult-like Road of Metamorphosis.
